Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 recc_num number(10);
begin
nullchk;
if :s_select = 'TEST ID' then
:s_test_id := :s_value;
 select test_desc into :s_test_desc 
 from valid_tests 
 where test_id = :s_test_id;
end if;
 if :s_select in ('LOT NUMBER', 'REAGENT ID', 'KIT LOT NUMBER') then
 select test_id into :s_test_id
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where :s_value =decode(:s_select, 'TEST ID', test_id, 
 'REAGENT ID', reagent_id, 
 'LOT NUMBER',lot_number,
 'KIT LOT NUMBER', kit_lot_number) 
 and trunc(expiry_date) > trunc(sysdate) 
 and reagent_status != 'Hold' 
 and remaining_tests > 0 
 and visual_qc_flag != 'N' 
 and (:global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
 or (lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code));
 if :s_test_id is not null then
 select test_desc into :s_test_desc 
 from valid_tests 
 where test_id = :s_test_id;
 else
 :s_test_desc := null;
 end if;
 end if;
 select count(*) into recc_num 
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where :s_value =decode(:s_select, 'TEST ID', test_id, 
 'REAGENT ID', reagent_id, 
 'LOT NUMBER',lot_number,
 'KIT LOT NUMBER', kit_lot_number) 
 and trunc(expiry_date) > trunc(sysdate) 
 and reagent_status != 'Hold' 
 and remaining_tests > 0 
 and visual_qc_flag != 'N' 
 and (:global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
 or (lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code)) 
 and test_id = nvl(:s_test_id, test_id);
if recc_num > 0 then
go_block('reagent_store_mst');
execute_query;
else
show_error('2319');
end if;
exception when no_data_found then
show_error('2319');
check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: UPDATE_QUANTITY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
NEW_INV number(10); 
IN_HAND number(10);
CHK_OUT_INV number(10);
begin

 
 
 
 begin
 select nvl(test_kit_seq,1000)+1
 into :GLOBAL.test_kit_id
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 update chapters
 set test_kit_seq = :GLOBAL.test_kit_id
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0090');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 
 begin
 go_record(1);
 
while :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 loop
 if :get_rec = 'X' and :reject_reason_code is not null and :out_quan is not null then 
if :out_quan <= 0 then 
show_error('1810');
exit;
else
IN_HAND := :remaining_tests;
CHK_OUT_INV := :out_quan;
if IN_HAND >= CHK_OUT_INV then

 NEW_INV := IN_HAND - CHK_OUT_INV;
:reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := NEW_INV; 
 down;
else
show_error('2325');
exit;
end if;
end if;
 else
down;
 end if; 
 
 
end loop;
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
then
 if :get_rec = 'X' and :reject_reason_code is not null and :out_quan is not null then
if :out_quan <= 0 then 
show_error('1810');
 
else

IN_HAND := :remaining_tests;
CHK_OUT_INV := :out_quan;
if IN_HAND >= CHK_OUT_INV then
 NEW_INV := IN_HAND - CHK_OUT_INV;
 
 :remaining_tests := NEW_INV;
else
show_error('2325');
end if;
 
end if; 
 end if;
 
 end if; 
 
 end;

 
 
 
exception
when value_error then
show_error('2319');
when NO_DATA_FOUND then
show_error('2306');

 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

go_record(1);
while :system.last_record = 'FALSE' loop
if :get_rec = 'X' and :reject_reason_code is not null and :out_quan is not null and :out_quan > 0 and :out_quan <= :remaining_tests then
 :global.rec_ok := '1';
 :global.x_present := '11';
down;
elsif :get_rec = 'X' and (:out_quan < 0 or :out_quan > :remaining_tests) then
 :global.rec_ok := '2';
show_error('2330');
exit;
elsif :get_rec = 'X' and (:reject_reason_code is null or :out_quan is null ) then
 :global.rec_ok := '2';
show_error('2311');
 exit;
 elsif :get_rec is null and (:reject_reason_code is not null or :out_quan is not null) then
 :global.rec_ok := '3';
show_error('2330');
 exit;
elsif :get_rec is null and :reject_reason_code is null and :out_quan is null then
 :global.rec_ok := 4;
down;
end if;
end loop;

if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
if :get_rec = 'X' and :reject_reason_code is not null and :out_quan is not null and :out_quan > 0 and :out_quan <= :remaining_tests then
 :global.rec_ok := '1';
 :global.x_present := '11';
elsif :get_rec = 'X' and ( :out_quan < 0 or :out_quan > :remaining_tests) then
 :global.rec_ok := '2';
show_error('2330');
elsif :get_rec = 'X' and (:reject_reason_code is null or :out_quan is null ) then
show_error('2311');

 :global.rec_ok := '2';

 elsif :get_rec = null and (:reject_reason_code is not null or :out_quan is not null) then
 :global.rec_ok := '3';
show_error('2330');
elsif :get_rec is null and :reject_reason_code is null and :out_quan is null then
 :global.rec_ok := 4;
end if;
end if;
 

if :global.rec_ok in ('1','4') and :global.x_present = '11' then
execute_trigger('update_quantity');
execute_trigger('validate_record');
commit; bell;
show_error('0000');
clear_block;
go_item('s_select');
else
show_error('2310');
rollback;
end if;
exception when value_error then
show_error('2319');
check_package_failure;
when others then 
check_package_failure;
handle_error;
end;
